# Nomada

> > Nomada is a comprehensive resource for digital nomads covering visas, taxes, connectivity, coworking spaces, and practical travel guides across Europe, the US, and global destinations.

Nomada provides bilingual (English/Spanish) guides for remote workers and digital nomads, featuring detailed information on work permits, tax residency rules, eSIM connectivity solutions like Holafly, coworking spaces in major cities like Lisbon and Porto, and practical advice for location-independent professionals navigating life abroad.

## Key Topics

- Digital nomad visas and work permits
- Tax residency and 183-day rule
- eSIM and connectivity solutions (Holafly)
- Coworking spaces and coliving
- Portugal (Lisbon, Porto, Algarve)
- European Union visa requirements
- Remote work lifestyle
- International Driving Permit
- State and federal taxes (US)
- Schengen area regulations
- Budget travel for nomads
- Emergency procedures abroad
- Transport options for nomads

## Visas & Work Permits

- [Digital nomad in Europe: full guide to getting your work visa](https://nomada.co/digital-nomad/work-permit-visa-europe): Europe work visa guide: Schengen requirements for digital nomads
- [Spain work permit visa](https://nomada.co/spain/spain-work-permit-visa): Spain work visa guide: requirements, process for non-EU nationals

## Taxes & Financial Planning

- [Taxes in the United States for digital nomads](https://nomada.co/united-states/taxes-united-states-digital-nomads): US tax guide: federal/state rules, 183-day residency, double taxation

- [Mejor VPN Arabia Saudí: navega seguro en 2025](https://nomada.co/es/arabia-saudita/vpn-arabia-saudi): Saudi Arabia VPN guide: security, censorship bypass, installation (ES)
